causal_question: When hidden ACK histories are not uniquely identified, can an actual common native action certified for all currently maintained complete target histories avoid a private read, while using public motion history identification ONLY if this action is inadmissible? Physically test rather than splice old baselines.
novelty_boundary: Worst-case common-action certificates, finite history hypotheses, risk-sensitive queries, and active adaptation are prior-art classes. Hypothesized contribution is the observed selective union and source-level negative counterfactuals, not a newly proved generic algorithm or robot safety guarantee.

hybrid_method_frozen.name: Action-Equivalence First (AEF)
hybrid_method_frozen.at_step5: With complete target-history belief and desired source target from policy, attempt documented multi-history bounded native controller-action certificate (same geometric position budget 0.05m and rotation budget 0.05rad) WITHOUT choosing an ACK history. If certificate authorizes, dispatch its common native action; keep complete belief and do not query. If certificate rejects, use original fixed-epsilon t4 public motion witness (task original Pull .006944262561376447m and Stack .00719087965534261m, competing margin .002m) to select EXACTLY one complete SE(3) history only if unique. If no trustworthy unique public candidate, one counted authoritative native target getter at t5 before dispatch.
hybrid_method_frozen.after_step5: If the belief remained multiple (since common native action was used), try the same robust common multi-history command at each later step; at first geometric infeasibility, make ONE counted native target read and collapse; if reader was already used, refuse rather than fabricate additional getters.
hybrid_method_frozen.priority: robust multi-history certificate > source-frozen public unique complete history > one counted authoritative target read
hybrid_method_frozen.no_future_leak: Never use actual t2/t3 physical applied/held truth, source seed/gain mode or audit-only private native target in decision. No public response regression retuning based on prior OOD outcomes.
hybrid_method_frozen.action_bound_caveat: Bounds apply to commanded target under documented chart, not real robot collision/contact force/hardware safety.
